factors.name: Corporate lending — WACI default
factors.basis: PCAF attribution — weighted average carbon intensity

source.document: No source recorded in the code this replaces

factors.note: Provenance not established. A portfolio-wide WACI default is a placeholder, not a factor — PCAF data quality score 4-5 territory by construction, since scores 1-2 exist only where the counterparty supplied the data. Our own financed-emissions briefing argues this is the binding constraint. Users must override it.

factors.name: Project finance — intensity default

source.document: No source recorded in the code this replaces

factors.note: Default withdrawn. The inherited value of 0.035 tCO2e/USD mn sat roughly 4,000x below the corporate-lending default in the same units, which is not plausible for project finance as an asset class. No sourced replacement could be established, and inventing one would be worse than shipping none — so the line now contributes nothing until the user supplies an intensity. Registered at zero to record the deliberate absence.

factors.note: The superseded GHG_EF table carried 0.58 tCO2e/t for the same line from the same nominal source. 0.467 is the value that was reaching users and the one the CSV export also hardcoded, so it is recorded here. The disagreement is unresolved — flagged for sourcing.

factors.name: Business travel — air, distance-based

source.document: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors — business travel, air

factors.note: Equals 0.1 kgCO2e/passenger-km. The superseded GHG_EF table carried haul-band factors of 0.151 (short), 0.131 (medium) and 0.195 (long) kgCO2e/pkm, none of which this matches, and none of which were ever used. A single blended factor also discards the haul-band and cabin-class distinctions the source makes. Flagged for sourcing.
